phases.name: Project Scaffolding
phases.description: Project structure, tooling, JSON-LD types, adapter interfaces, default config.

phases.name: Missing Metadata Type Factories
phases.description: ConflictReport, ResolvedFromAnnotation, ShadowsAnnotation, DisambiguatedFromAnnotation — metadata types needed by ScopeResolver (Phase 12). 6 factories, 27 tests.

phases.name: Identity Simplification
phases.description: 7-step deterministic normalization pipeline producing canonicalLabel for all concept matching.

phases.name: NLParser & Classifier
phases.description: Deterministic regex-based NLParser (7 step functions) and enum-routing Classifier. 45-entry golden corpus. 130 new tests.

phases.name: InMemoryStateAdapter
phases.description: Reference in-memory state adapter with 5 maintained indices (canonicalLabel, parent, children, properties, reverse relationships). Atomic snapshot-and-swap mutations. 86 tests, browser test harness.

phases.name: Validator
phases.description: Pure-function validator: compound statement rejection, structural grounding, cycle detection (CVS-005), property redundancy (duplicate/ancestor/descendant), relationship basics, modification/deletion/merge checks. 104 new tests across 6 suites.

phases.name: OCE/IEE Governance Stubs
phases.description: Null governance implementations: checkGovernanceBlock (blocking-flag-as-EpistemicFailure), nullOCECheck (always coherent), nullIEECheck (never contested), createGovernanceEpistemicFailure factory.

phases.name: Classification Workflow
phases.description: First full knowledge workflow: NLParser → Classifier → KnowledgeEngine → Validator → StateAdapter. 'X is a Y' creates/locates both concepts, establishes IS_A, validates, applies. 4 mutation cases (both new, object exists, both exist, object new). Ambiguity handling (ConversationPrompt for disambiguation), unknown-parent negotiation, ScopeResolver null stub, DescriptionEngine stub. 20-entry golden corpus. 80 new tests across 4 suites.

phases.name: Property Workflow
phases.description: Property assignment workflow: full 'X has Y' pipeline with scope narrowing and Leap Check optimization. O(log d) prompt reduction for deep hierarchies via binary search. Property value type routing (string vs concept-reference). Descendant removal on property promotion. DescriptionEngine enhanced with property listing. 16-entry golden corpus, 71 new tests across 5 suites (4 new + 1 extended).

phases.name: DescriptionEngine
phases.description: Auto-generates human-readable descriptions from graph structure. Article selection (a/an), display label capitalization, property listing with Oxford comma, process template with gerund morphology. 25-entry golden corpus, 52 new tests across 2 suites.

phases.name: Pipeline Integration
phases.description: Convergence gate. SynchronousOrchestrationAdapter routes utterances to classification/property/relationship pipelines. NullIntegrationAdapter for offline mode. 22-entry conversation simulation corpus (14 core + 8 adversarial). TagTeam Decision Gate: regex NLParser at 100%, ADR-003 accepted.

phases.name: Relationships & Termidium
phases.description: Custom relationship workflow ('X verb Y'), verb normalization (deterministic suffix-stripping lemmatizer), 7 validation checks (duplicate, inverse, hierarchy, reuse, promotion, refactoring, same-subtree), sub-relationship detection, Termidium 8-level bounded deduplication with 3-tier merge policy. 15-entry golden corpus, 88 new tests across 5 new suites.

phases.name: ExportEngine
phases.description: Deterministic export of knowledge graphs to SKOS, OWL, RDF/XML, and Turtle formats. Shared triple extraction layer, Turtle and XML serializers, vocabulary-specific filters. 80 new tests across 5 suites.

phases.name: Session Lifecycle
phases.description: Conversation session management, persistence, and state recovery.

phases.name: ScopeResolver & Federation
phases.description: Cross-graph scope resolution and federated knowledge queries. Needs ConflictReport, ResolvedFrom, ShadowsAnnotation, DisambiguatedFrom factories (complete).

phases.name: M2M Protocol
phases.description: Machine-to-machine protocol for inter-agent knowledge exchange.

phases.name: Ecosystem Adapters
phases.description: Platform-specific adapters for browser, Electron, cloud, and edge runtimes.
